author: iFixit
description:
Over the years we’ve watched in disbelief as Sony took the highly repairable XM3’s and nerfed them to the point where you’d need a rework station and micro-welding equipment for what used to be a simple battery replacement. 

With highly repairable options like the Fairbuds on the market, has Sony finally upped their game with the XM6?
